Students Training

  • Colleges
  • College of Management & Technology
  • Students Training

Internships can be an important asset to students' overall educational experience. Internship experiences often help students confirm their career interests, give them hands-on experience in a professional setting, help build their resume, reinforce what they’ve learned in class and can often lead to full-time employment. Likewise, pursuing professional research opportunities as an undergraduate student can also help enrich his/her academic experience while at the University. Therefore, undergraduate students should work closely with faculty research mentors (determined by the department) to explore disciplines that interest them. Both internship and research opportunities help you build a competitive edge in the job market; therefore, it becomes a main pass/fail condition for your graduation.

 

College of Management and Technology Alamein provides different training opportunities for students to bridge the gap between academia and the actual business sector through summer training.College of Management and Technology Alamein offers training opportunities for undergraduate students during the summer vacation where students are trained in well-established companies from diverse business and industrial sectors in Egypt.

Petrochemicals Company Training (Summer 2021-2022)

            

Webco Company Training (Summer 2021 - 2022)
